steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Globalisation is the increasing interconnection of world economies through trade, investment, and technology - it means businesses can operate internationally more easily. | Key Fact: Multinational corporations (MNCs) operate in multiple countries: they benefit from lower labour costs and new markets but face cultural differences and complex regulations. | Key Fact: Employment law protects workers: National Minimum Wage, Working Time Regulations, Health and Safety at Work Act, Equality Act (preventing discrimination). | Key Fact: Consumer protection legislation (Consumer Rights Act 2015) ensures products are as described, fit for purpose, and of satisfactory quality - giving consumers the right to refunds, repairs, or replacements.

steps.title: Lesson 3: Application
steps.body: Explain two benefits and two drawbacks of globalisation for a UK business. | Describe how the Consumer Rights Act 2015 protects customers and affects businesses. | Evaluate whether employment legislation does more harm than good to businesses.
